blocks.text: 89books publishes Entre Loup et Chien by Werner Mansholt . The book will be presented at PARIS PHOTO Polycopies at the 89books stand. Werner Mansholt will be there for a book signing on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 6.00 pm.

This gives rise to a symbolic level that delves deeply into human experience. In a figurative sense, it represents, so to speak, the dissolution of clear boundaries and the transition between the rational and the imaginary.

It is a state of ambivalence: the familiar loses its contours, while the unfamiliar is not yet fully comprehensible. Neon light and deep shadows, pitch-black darkness and moonlight, familiar spaces and unknown premonitions. In the glaring light, the colors—symbols of life and joy—shine brightly. In the twilight looms a sense of unease.

“In perceiving the atmosphere, I sense the kind of environment I find myself in. This perception thus has two sides: on the one hand, the environment, which radiates a certain mood; on the other hand, myself, as I participate in this mood through my state of mind and become aware that I am here and now. […] Conversely, atmospheres are the way in which things and environments present themselves.” (Gernot Böhme, Atmosphere , Frankfurt 1975).
